title: Propose a Shared Garden Bed

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料；尚待独立教学与发音审核。

instructions: Write your own response. The example is for study and is not a submission.
prompt: Write 120–180 words to a fictional community group about a shared garden bed. Describe what you want to grow, where you would put it, and one plan for rain. Explain one general condition and use at least six lesson words.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: 先说明花坛和植物；再写位置、工具与共同决定；最后用 if 或 unless 描述条件，并核对至少六个本课词。

reference: I would like our fictional group to share one small garden bed. We could sow a seed for each kind of herb and put a card beside the row. I would choose basil and parsley for the bed and keep mint in a pot nearby. The place gets sunlight in the morning and shade later, so we should check the notice before we decide. I can bring a bucket, and another member can return the rake and shovel after the work. If a seed gets suitable warmth and water, it can sprout. If the earth is dry, we can ask the staff what the local rules say about water. We will meet outside unless it rains heavily; in that case, we can discuss the plan indoors. I hope we can enjoy a small harvest and watch a butterfly or bee without disturbing it. Everyone should have a chance to help choose the crop.
referenceLabel: 原创示例，仅供学习；不要作为自己的待提交作文。
